direction: Idea Wall: dark, rich, organized. Background: near-black #0b0c0f covered edge to edge by a subtle masonry wall of flat rounded tiles in #13151a and #181b22 with 24px gaps, echoing the brand mark; three of the tiles are accent blue #4f8fe0 at 25% opacity; no glow, no gradient. Typography: a bold geometric condensed sans like Barlow Semi Condensed Bold, ALL CAPS headline with 2% letter spacing, headline color #ebedf5, accent word color #4f8fe0, subheadline sentence case #9aa0b4. Device: iPhone 17 Pro Max, black frame, thin bezels, soft shadow, perfectly straight and centered, its bottom running off the canvas. Decoration: The character, named Tilly: the brand's tall rounded tile turned into a small friendly creature. Body = one tall rounded rectangle tile (corner radius about 18% of its width), flat #ebedf5 off-white, no outline, no gradient. Two small round #0b0c0f eyes near the top, a small calm smile, two short rounded stubby arms in the same color as the body, no legs, no ears, no nose. It carries or interacts with a small square tile in accent blue #4f8fe0 that looks like a saved idea card. Flat 2D vector style, outline-free, soft and rounded like the Headspace characters, consistent proportions (body height about 1.5x its width). Here the character is smaller (about 15% of canvas height) and peeks out from behind the phone's right edge.

layouts.top_straight: Layout: text-top, device-bottom: headline block in the top 28% of the canvas (top 6% free of text, first line starts at 7% of the canvas height), left-aligned at a 7% margin; a 1px hairline across the text column below the subheadline; the phone straight and centered below it, its bottom edge running off the bottom of the canvas so the phone appears large; the character about 15% of canvas height peeks from behind the phone's {side} edge, never covering UI text.
layouts.bottom: Layout: device-top: the phone straight and centered occupies the top 64% of the canvas with its top edge running off the top of the canvas (status bar and Dynamic Island not visible), cropped so the first visible UI element sits within the top 4% of the canvas; the character about 15% of canvas height peeks from behind the phone's {side} edge just above the text block; the headline block and subheadline sit in the bottom 30% of the canvas, left-aligned at the 7% margin, with a 1px hairline above the headline, bottom 6% free of text.
